missions.briefingKo: 드디어 여행이 시작됐어요. 항공사 직원에게 써니 시티로 간다고 말하고, 부칠 짐이 1개라고 알려 준 뒤 탑승권을 받으세요.
missions.openingEn: Good morning. Where are you flying today, and how many bags would you like to check?
missions.openingKo: 좋은 아침입니다. 오늘 어디로 가시며, 부칠 짐은 몇 개인가요?

goals.descriptionEn: Clearly state that Sunny City is the flight destination.
State that there is exactly one bag or suitcase to check.
Ask for the boarding pass or clearly acknowledge receiving it.

hints: I'm flying to Sunny City today.
I have one suitcase to check.
Could I have my boarding pass, please?

missions.briefingKo: 보안 검색과 출국 심사 차례예요. 여권과 탑승권을 보여 주고, 노트북과 전자기기를 가방에서 꺼냈다고 알려 주세요.
missions.openingEn: Please have your passport and boarding pass ready. Have you taken your laptop and electronics out of your bag?
missions.openingKo: 여권과 탑승권을 준비해 주세요. 노트북과 전자기기를 가방에서 꺼내셨나요?

goals.descriptionEn: Offer or show the passport when the officer asks for it.
Offer or show the boarding pass to the officer.
Confirm that the laptop or other electronics have been removed from the bag for screening.

hints: Here are my passport and boarding pass.
Yes, I took my laptop out of my bag.

missions.briefingKo: 탑승이 시작됐어요. 승무원에게 탑승권을 보여 주고 18A 좌석이 어디인지 물은 뒤, 가방을 머리 위 선반에 넣어도 되는지 확인하세요.
missions.openingEn: Welcome aboard. May I see your boarding pass? Do you need help finding your seat?
missions.openingKo: 탑승을 환영합니다. 탑승권을 보여 주시겠어요? 좌석을 찾는 데 도움이 필요하신가요?

goals.descriptionEn: Show or offer the boarding pass while boarding the aircraft.
Ask where seat 18A is or ask for help finding that seat.

goals.labelKo: 가방을 위 선반에 넣어도 되는지 묻기
goals.descriptionEn: Ask whether the carry-on bag may be placed in the overhead compartment.

hints: Here is my boarding pass.
Where is seat 18A?
Can I put this bag in the overhead compartment?

missions.briefingKo: 비행기가 순항 중이고 기내식 시간이 됐어요. 치킨과 파스타 중 먹고 싶은 식사를 고르고, 마실 음료도 정중하게 요청하세요.
missions.openingEn: For lunch, would you like chicken or pasta? And what would you like to drink?
missions.openingKo: 점심으로 치킨과 파스타 중 무엇을 드시겠어요? 음료는 무엇으로 드릴까요?

goals.descriptionEn: Choose either chicken or pasta, or another meal option offered by the attendant.
Ask for a specific drink such as water, juice, coffee, or tea.
Make the meal or drink request politely using please, could I, or an equivalent phrase.

hints: I'd like the chicken, please.
Could I have some orange juice?

missions.briefingKo: 써니 시티에 도착했어요. 심사관에게 여권을 보여 주고, 휴가 여행이며 4일 동안 머문다고 설명하세요.
missions.openingEn: Welcome to Sunny City. May I see your passport? What is the purpose of your visit, and how long will you stay?
missions.openingKo: 써니 시티에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 여권을 보여 주시겠어요? 방문 목적과 체류 기간은 어떻게 되나요?

goals.descriptionEn: Acknowledge the request and hand over or offer the passport.
State any plausible reason for visiting, such as vacation, sightseeing, visiting family, study, or work.
State an understandable length of stay, with four days matching the travel story.

hints: Here is my passport.
I'm here on vacation.
I'll stay for four days.

missions.briefingKo: 입국심사를 마치고 수하물 찾는 곳에 왔어요. 직원에게 내 항공편의 수하물 벨트 번호를 묻고, 검은색 큰 여행가방에 빨간 리본이 있다고 설명하세요.
missions.openingEn: Hello. Which flight did you arrive on, and what does your suitcase look like?
missions.openingKo: 안녕하세요. 어느 항공편으로 도착하셨고, 여행가방은 어떻게 생겼나요?

goals.descriptionEn: Ask which baggage carousel or belt is assigned to the arriving flight.
Describe the suitcase clearly, including useful details such as size, color, or a red ribbon.

hints: Which carousel is for flight SC218?
My bag is a large black suitcase with a red ribbon.

missions.briefingKo: 짐을 찾고 공항 밖으로 나왔어요. 택시 기사에게 지금 이용 가능한지 확인하고, 탈 수 있는지 정중하게 부탁하세요.
missions.openingEn: Hello there. Are you looking for a taxi?
missions.openingKo: 안녕하세요. 택시를 찾고 계신가요?

goals.descriptionEn: Ask whether the taxi or driver is available for a ride now.
Politely ask to take the taxi using please, could you, may I, or an equivalent expression.

hints: Are you available now?
Could you take me, please?

missions.briefingKo: 택시에 탔어요. 써니 가든 호텔로 가 달라고 말하고, 예상 요금을 물어본 뒤 무거운 여행가방을 트렁크에 실어 달라고 부탁하세요.
missions.openingEn: Sure, I can take you. Where are you heading, and do you need help with your luggage?
missions.openingKo: 네, 모셔다드릴게요. 어디로 가시며, 짐을 싣는 데 도움이 필요하신가요?

goals.labelKo: 써니 가든 호텔로 가 달라고 말하기
goals.descriptionEn: Tell the driver that the destination is the Sunny Garden Hotel or clearly name the hotel.
Ask how much the ride will cost or what the approximate fare is.
Ask the driver for help putting the suitcase or luggage into the trunk.

hints: Please take me to the Sunny Garden Hotel.
About how much will the fare be?
Could you help me put this suitcase in the trunk?

missions.briefingKo: 호텔 프런트에 도착했어요. 예약자 이름이 Jin Kim이라고 말하고, 3박 예약을 확인한 뒤 여권을 보여 주세요.
missions.openingEn: Welcome to the Sunny Garden Hotel. Do you have a reservation with us?
missions.openingKo: 써니 가든 호텔에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 예약하셨나요?

goals.descriptionEn: State the name on the hotel reservation, with Jin Kim matching the travel story.
State that the hotel stay is for three nights or give another clear booked duration.
Offer or show the passport when the front desk needs identification.

hints: I have a reservation under Jin Kim.
I'm staying for three nights.
Here is my passport.

missions.briefingKo: 방에 들어왔는데 수건이 부족해요. 객실 전화로 호텔 안내 직원에게 연결한 뒤, 수건 2장을 방으로 가져다 달라고 정중하게 부탁하세요.
missions.openingEn: Hotel information. How may I help you this evening?
missions.openingKo: 호텔 인포메이션입니다. 오늘 저녁 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

goals.descriptionEn: Clearly ask the hotel to bring towels to the room.
Clearly request exactly two towels.
Use a polite request, for example could I, would you, please, or an equally polite form.

hints: Could I have two towels, please?
Would you bring them to my room?

missions.titleKo: 미션 11 · 호텔에 택시를 불러 달라고 하라!
missions.briefingKo: 저녁 식사를 하러 나갈 시간이에요. 호텔 컨시어지에게 오후 6시 20분에 정문으로 택시를 불러 달라고 정중하게 요청하세요.
missions.openingEn: Concierge desk. What can I arrange for you?
missions.openingKo: 컨시어지 데스크입니다. 무엇을 준비해 드릴까요?

goals.descriptionEn: Ask the hotel or concierge to call or arrange a taxi.
Give a clear pickup time, with 6:20 p.m. matching the travel story.
Make the taxi request politely using could you, please, or an equivalent phrase.

hints: Could you call a taxi for me, please?
I'd like it at the front entrance at 6:20 p.m.

missions.briefingKo: 호텔 앞에 예약한 택시가 도착했어요. 기사에게 리버사이드 스테이크하우스로 가 달라고 목적지를 분명하고 정중하게 말하세요.
missions.openingEn: Good evening. Where would you like to go?
missions.openingKo: 좋은 저녁입니다. 어디로 모셔다드릴까요?

goals.descriptionEn: Tell the driver that the destination is the Riverside Steakhouse or clearly name a restaurant.
Politely ask the driver to take the traveler to the restaurant.

hints: Please take me to the Riverside Steakhouse.
It's the restaurant near the river.

missions.briefingKo: 식당에 도착했어요. 예약이 없어도 괜찮은지 확인하며 2명이 앉을 테이블을 정중하게 요청하세요.
missions.openingEn: Welcome to the Riverside Steakhouse. Do you have a reservation tonight?
missions.openingKo: 리버사이드 스테이크하우스에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 오늘 저녁 예약하셨나요?

goals.descriptionEn: Ask the host for a table even if there is no reservation.
Clearly say that the table is for exactly two people.
Use a polite request such as please, could we, or an equivalent form.

hints: We don't have a reservation.
Could we have a table for two, please?

missions.briefingKo: 자리에 앉아 메뉴를 골랐어요. 종업원에게 스테이크 1개, 립아이 1개, 그리고 음료 2개를 빠뜨리지 말고 주문하세요.
missions.openingEn: Your table is ready. Would you like a few more minutes, or are you ready to order?
missions.openingKo: 자리가 준비됐습니다. 메뉴를 더 보시겠어요, 아니면 주문하시겠어요?

goals.descriptionEn: Order one regular steak as a separate item.
Order one rib-eye steak as a separate item.
Order exactly two drinks, either by quantity or by naming two drinks.

hints: We'd like one steak and one rib-eye, please.
Could we also have two drinks?
One lemonade and one orange juice, please.

missions.titleKo: 미션 15 · 식사 중 추가 주문을 하라!
missions.briefingKo: 식사를 하다 보니 음식과 물이 조금 더 필요해졌어요. 원하는 사이드 메뉴나 음식을 하나 더 주문하고, 마실 물도 정중하게 요청하세요.
missions.openingEn: How is everything? Can I bring you anything else?
missions.openingKo: 식사는 어떠신가요? 더 가져다드릴 것이 있을까요?

goals.descriptionEn: Order an additional food item, side dish, or dessert during the meal.
Ask the server to bring water, a glass of water, or more water.
Use a polite request such as could we have, please, or an equivalent form.

hints: Could we also order a side of fries?
And could we have some water, please?

missions.briefingKo: 맛있게 식사를 마쳤어요. 종업원에게 계산서를 정중하게 요청하고, 카드로 결제하고 싶다고 말하세요.
missions.openingEn: I hope you enjoyed your meal. Is there anything else I can get for you?
missions.openingKo: 식사는 맛있게 드셨나요? 더 필요한 것이 있으신가요?

goals.descriptionEn: Ask the server to bring the bill, check, or receipt for the meal.
State that the bill will be paid by card or ask whether card payment is accepted.
Make the billing request politely using please, could we, or an equivalent expression.

hints: Could we have the bill, please?
I'd like to pay by card.

missions.briefingKo: 아침 쇼핑을 하러 왔어요. 직원에게 네이비색 M 사이즈 재킷을 찾고 있다고 말하고, 직접 입어 봐도 되는지 물어보세요.
missions.openingEn: Good morning! What are you looking for today?
missions.openingKo: 좋은 아침입니다! 오늘 무엇을 찾고 계세요?

goals.descriptionEn: Tell the clerk that the desired item is a jacket.
Specify both navy as the color and medium or size M as the size.
Ask permission to try the jacket on.
goals.hintKo: 확인할 것: 입어 보기 가능 여부

hints: I'm looking for a navy jacket in size M.
May I try it on?

missions.titleKo: 미션 18 · 박물관 표와 관람 규칙을 확인하라!
missions.briefingKo: 쇼핑을 마치고 박물관에 도착했어요. 어린이 표 2장을 사고, 전시실 안에서 사진을 찍어도 되는지 관람 규칙을 물어보세요.
missions.openingEn: Welcome to the Sunny City Museum. What tickets would you like today?
missions.openingKo: 써니 시티 박물관에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 오늘 어떤 표가 필요하신가요?

goals.descriptionEn: Request exactly two children's admission tickets.
Ask whether taking photos is allowed inside the exhibits.

hints: Two children's tickets, please.
Are we allowed to take photos inside?

missions.briefingKo: 박물관 관람 뒤 가까운 공원에 왔어요. 대여 직원에게 자전거 2대를 1시간 동안 빌리고 싶다고 말하고, 헬멧도 포함되는지 확인하세요.
missions.openingEn: Hello! Would you like to rent bikes for the park?
missions.openingKo: 안녕하세요! 공원에서 탈 자전거를 빌리시겠어요?

goals.descriptionEn: Ask to rent exactly two bicycles.
Say that the bicycle rental is for one hour.
Ask whether helmets are included with the rental or available.

hints: We'd like to rent two bikes for one hour.
Are helmets included?

missions.titleKo: 미션 20 · 아픈 친구를 위해 약국 도움을 구하라!
missions.briefingKo: 공원에서 돌아오던 중 친구가 갑자기 아파졌어요. 친구가 배가 아프고 어지럽다고 설명한 뒤, 가장 가까운 약국이 어디인지 물어보세요.
missions.openingEn: Hello. You look worried. What happened, and how can I help?
missions.openingKo: 안녕하세요. 걱정스러워 보이네요. 무슨 일이 있고, 어떻게 도와드릴까요?

goals.descriptionEn: Explain that the friend has a stomachache or stomach pain.
Explain that the friend feels dizzy or lightheaded.
Ask where the nearest pharmacy is or how to get there.

hints: My friend has a stomachache and feels dizzy.
Where is the nearest pharmacy?

missions.titleKo: 미션 21 · 하우스키퍼에게 나중에 와 달라고 하라!
missions.briefingKo: 체크아웃 준비 중인데 하우스키퍼가 방에 왔어요. 지금은 외출 준비 중이라고 설명하고, 1시간 뒤에 다시 와 달라고 정중하게 부탁하세요.
missions.openingEn: Housekeeping. Would you like me to clean your room now?
missions.openingKo: 하우스키핑입니다. 지금 방을 청소해 드릴까요?

goals.descriptionEn: Explain that the traveler is getting ready to go out or is not ready for cleaning now.
Ask the housekeeper to return or clean the room one hour later.
Make the request politely with please, could you, thank you, or an equivalent expression.

hints: We're getting ready to go out.
Could you come back in one hour, please?

missions.briefingKo: 여행의 마지막 날이에요. 프런트 직원에게 체크아웃하겠다고 말하고, 미니바는 사용하지 않았으며 공항으로 가기 전까지 짐을 잠시 맡기고 싶다고 설명하세요.
missions.openingEn: Good morning. Are you checking out today? Did you use anything from the minibar?
missions.openingKo: 좋은 아침입니다. 오늘 체크아웃하시나요? 미니바에서 사용하신 물품이 있나요?

goals.descriptionEn: Clearly state the intention to check out of the hotel now.
State that nothing from the minibar was used or consumed.
Ask the hotel to store or hold the luggage temporarily after checkout.

hints: I'd like to check out, please.
I didn't use anything from the minibar.
Could you hold my luggage for a little while?

missions.briefingKo: 호텔에서 짐을 찾아 귀국길에 올랐어요. 기사에게 공항 제2터미널로 가 달라고 말하고, 이 터미널이 맞는지 확인한 뒤 여행가방을 실어 달라고 부탁하세요.
missions.openingEn: Your taxi is ready. Where would you like to go, and can I help with your bags?
missions.openingKo: 택시가 준비됐습니다. 어디로 가시며, 짐을 싣는 것을 도와드릴까요?

goals.descriptionEn: Tell the driver that the destination is the airport.
Ask whether Terminal 2 is the correct terminal for the airline or flight.
Ask the driver for help loading the suitcase or luggage into the taxi.

hints: Please take me to the airport.
Is Terminal 2 correct for Sunny Air?
Could you help me with this suitcase?

missions.titleKo: 미션 24 · 변경된 탑승구에서 마지막 탑승을 하라!
missions.briefingKo: 귀국편 탑승구가 갑자기 12번으로 바뀌었어요. 직원에게 12번 탑승구 위치와 탑승 시작 시간을 묻고, 마지막으로 탑승권을 보여 주며 비행기에 타세요.
missions.openingEn: Your flight has moved to gate 12. May I help you before final boarding?
missions.openingKo: 탑승하실 항공편이 12번 탑승구로 변경됐습니다. 최종 탑승 전에 도와드릴까요?

goals.descriptionEn: Ask where the newly assigned gate 12 is located.
Ask when boarding begins or what time final boarding takes place.
Offer or show the boarding pass to the gate agent for final boarding.

hints: Where is gate 12?
What time does boarding begin?
Here is my boarding pass.
